purpose: tier D1-anchor: identical to paper-contract-h32-4clip-seed0-v1 except anchor_obs=true (9-D reference anchor pose in the robot anchor frame appended to the goal); tests whether root drift and its checkpoint-to-checkpoint swing disappear when the actor can see its drift

paper_contract.action: absolute joint setpoint around default pose

implementation_conventions_not_in_paper.goal_features: 68 per frame from reference only (no robot state)
implementation_conventions_not_in_paper.wm_loss: Cuboi window_loss: sum over state dims, mean over batch; term BCE weight 1.0 (not changed)
implementation_conventions_not_in_paper.dr: Cuboi: torso COM offset at startup, encoder bias and foot friction 0.3-1.2 per reset

deviations_from_paper_contract: GPU = RTX 5090 or L40S instead of H100
per-session max_hours 1.2; multi-session warm restarts (replay/RNG/sim not restored)
anchor_obs=true: +9-D anchor observation (torso_link, mjlab motion_anchor_pos_b/ori_b) with uniform noise ±0.25 m / ±0.05; NOT the paper observation, scored on the +anchor line

eval.checkpoints: initial + every 2000 it + end of each session + final

acceptance_for_entering_4clip: walk1 full clip completed with no physical failure and window10s completion 100%, or a clear diagnostic conclusion

clipset.source: LAFAN1 rev ce15729 converted on tier C Pod (deterministic vs 2026-11-03 for the 4 overlapping clips)

acceptance: same gate as the paper-observation 4clip run (4/4 full clips, 0 physical failures, window10s macro >= 0.80) plus: end-of-window pelvis yaw error and window macro stable across the last 3 checkpoints
variant_line: +anchor (scored separately from the paper-observation line; PIPELINE §12)
